messages:
sana: quick follow-up: brief cross-region LB retry burst this morning (us-east-1 -> eu-west-1) at ~05:07 UTC, ~10-15s spikes; a few TLS handshakes failed. creating a focused remediation thread.

omar: saw the same. route-controller ran a reconcile at 05:06 from an automated config job. connection traces show RST shortly after ClientHello in ~30% of flows.

kevin: looks like targets were deregistered during reconcile. health-check ejection timing is aggressive for global targets.

diana: i'll own the target-group tuning + add a short soft-dereg delay during reconciles. ETA: PR by tomorrow (MIT-357).

ryan: i'll investigate TLS stack for early aborts + SNI fallback behavior. will instrument `tls_abort_reason` and spike dashboard. TKT-834. ETA: Tue morning.

sana: plan summary: 1) soft-dereg + reconcile tag 4diana (MIT-357) 2) target-group health-check audit omar (INC-4480) 3) TLS instrumentation ryan (TKT-834) 4) alert tuning to require sustained >1m before paging kevin. post updates on the incident board.

kevin: changing alert to `rate(retry_cross_region[1m]) > 0.01 AND reconcile_in_progress==0` to reduce noise. will stage change Wed.

omar: initial audit: two cross-region groups use 5s interval and unhealthy threshold=1. recommending interval=10s + threshold=2 for global. will add details to INC-4480.

diana: soft-dereg PR posted to staging; test shows retry amplitude reduced ~60% in replay. including rollback knobs.

ryan: instrumented tls_abort_reason and added `sni_mismatch` counter. no cert chain issues found; most aborts align with deregistration window.

sre-bot: follow-up sync scheduled Thu 16:00 UTC.

sana: thanks all. check-in Fri EOD with final changes and runbook edits. ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
